purposes.command.document.object.item.edit: Edit an item (shape or image) of the open document.

resourceBoundary.policy: Complete correlated retained receipt or typed refusal; no document, glyph or pixel payload in either direction.

semantics: Create, edit and delete one raster item or one text block in the open native document. One request is one atomic revision and one undo entry; an effective no-op (same values) publishes nothing, keeps presence, bytes, history and redo, and reports applied=false. The owner allocates the id of a created item (strokeId is sent empty) and reports it. A text patch has no anchorTopLeft or rotation member: an edit never re-anchors or turns a block; a created block may carry rotation (degrees within one turn either way, about its anchor), which a Select turn also stores. A locked Drawing layer, a widget layer and a reference scope are refused; an unknown, wrong-kind or missing asset reference is a typed refusal. A text transaction may name a declared component context (its own layers and frames); it may carry keyframe "copy", and an edit or delete a landing frame, which keys a held scene cell with a copy of what it showed (records, text blocks and images, same ids) in the same revision before the edit lands there (a held component cell is refused as unavailable). The retained font provider is consulted at evaluation, not here, and its absence is that provider's typed unavailability. A text animator command may name the declared component whose layer holds the animators with an optional contextId (absent = the scene); an undeclared context is refused. No JS or Paper writer, no optimistic mutation.
